question: As per India Census 2011, which of the following languages after Hindi is spoken by the maximum number of people in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bengali__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per India Census 2011, Bengali is the language after Hindi that is spoken by the maximum number of people in India.
 
• As per the **Census 2011, 43.63% of Indians speak Hindi **as their **mother tongue**. **Bengali, with 8.03%** speakers, is **second on the list.**
 
• As per the** Census 2011, Marathi** is at the **3rd number with 6.86%.**
 
• **Telugu **is at the **4th number **with **6.70%**.
 
• As per the **Census 2011, ****Tamil **is at the **5th number with 5.7%.**
 
• As per the **Census 2011, ****Urdu **is at the** 7th number.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **15th Census** of** India **was **conducted in 2011.**​
 
• The **slogan** of the **Census **was **'Our Census Our Future'.**
 
• It was the **7th Census since independence**.
 
• **It covered:**
 
 
• **​640 - Districts**
 
• **497 - Cities**
 
• **5,924 - Sub-districts**
 
• **5,767 - Tehsils**
 
• **7,935 - Towns**
 
• **6,40,867- Villages**
 
 

86:T
